name: Glass Settings Screen
description: A dark, monochrome iOS settings screen for a journaling app: a title that folds into glass, springy switches, a snapping slider and sections that blur and count in.

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark by default; the light variant is designed, not inverted.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: switches, the slider, the selected time and Done.

props.name: profile
props.description: Name, email, plan, renewal, entries, streak and word count.

props.name: initial
props.description: Starting paper, text size, reminder, time, prompts, Face ID and sync values. This is the way to set a value at mount.

props.name: reminderTimes
props.description: Four reminder times shown when the row expands.

props.name: sample
props.description: Journal excerpt shown in the reading preview.

props.name: paper
props.description: Imperative nudge for a host or test: moves the reading paper whenever the value changes. Use initial for the starting paper; onChange stays the source of truth.

props.name: textSize
props.description: Imperative nudge: moves the text-size slider to this point size (14 to 22) whenever the value changes. Use initial for the starting size.

props.name: reminder
props.description: Imperative nudge: switches the daily reminder on or off whenever the value changes (the time row follows). Use initial for the starting state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the full state after any change.

props.name: onDeleteAll
props.description: Fired when deletion is confirmed in the sheet.
